title: Continuation and missing-work discipline
summary: Continue by importing the exact qualified runtime, reconciling newer Wire3D collector work, and qualifying real current producers. Do not grow a competing transport, logging system, topology authority or incident engine.
procedure: Resolve the newest qualified Instrumentation archive and verify its digest before source import.
Publish exact source and qualification evidence under the owned package path rather than reconstructing from sphere prose.
Resolve the Wire3D dev29.25 collector-join package and reconcile it with dev29.23 Keynote correlation/NOC behavior.
Re-run producer and live QueueRexx/XTP qualifications against the current estate.
Add any new service observation at the smallest owning service boundary, then project through Instrumentation.
Preserve complete-scope, replay, privacy and explicit-correlation semantics in every new adapter.
Update this sphere with exact evidence, limitations and supersession state.
do_not: Do not infer causation from time proximity.
Do not infer service failure from stale telemetry.
Do not merge forensic logging into Instrumentation.
Do not let the NOC become topology or service authority.
Do not silently overwrite a newer Wire3D line with the inspected dev29.23 package.
